claims.claim_ar: الآية توظف أسلوب الاستئناف/الربط (بكلمة التوكيد/الإشارة كَذَلِكَ) لتقديم حكم ربّي كخلاصة محكمة تُتمّ خطابًا سابقًا.
claims.claim_en: The verse employs an estinaf (resumption/connecting) device — the demonstrative 'كَذَلِكَ' links and emphasizes the prior argument, presenting the Lord's judgment as a concluded, decisive result.

warnings: Provided source_chunks are grammatical (I'rab) notes by Darwish; the requested classical balagha authors (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir balagha sections) are not present. Claims are therefore drawn from the available I'rab commentary and may lack direct citation from the classical balagha literature.
